title: KHETEY THEY HARAM ROOKER SAQQA E SAKINA
body:
KHETEY THEY HARAM ROOKER SAQQA E SAKINA
TOOTEY HAI SITAM HUMPAR SAQQA E SAKINA
1. JALTEY HAIN SAARE KHAIMEY SHOLOU KI ROUSHNI HAI
CHEEN THI HAI SAR SE CHADER SAQQA E SAKINA
<<DIVIDER>>
2. AB HAAL PER HAMARE HASTEY HAIN SAB SITAMGAR
BALWE MEIN HOON KHULEY SAR SAQQA E SAKINA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. KUCH INTEHA NAHI HAI ZULM O SITAM KI HUM PAR
AAJOU BEHREY DAWAR SAQQA E SAKINA
<<DIVIDER>>
4. SOJHEY HAIN GAAL USKE ROOTI HAI AB SAKINA
CHEENE GAYE HAIN GOUHER SAQQA E SAKINA
<<DIVIDER>>
5. SEHRAYE KARBALA MEIN AB KISKO HUM PUKAREY
QASIM HAI AUR NA AKBER SAQQA E SAKINA
<<DIVIDER>>
6. QAID E SITAM ME GHUTKER MARJAYEGI SAKINA
DEDO DILASA AAKER SAQQA E SAKINA
<<DIVIDER>>
7. KARBOBALA TA KHUFA THA YEH SOHAIL NOUHA
SAB BIBIYOUM KE LAB PER SAQQA E SAKINA
AZZ RAZA ALI SOHAIL
